title: PR #65271 — FileAccess.open is static and there is no close()

blocks.text:
This PR removes File/Directory from core binds and binds FileAccess /
DirAccess instead. The new classes have almost the same API as the old
ones, but there are some changes. Most notable changes are open() being
static and lack of a close() method. Migrated code that does file.close()
or `var f = File.new(); f.open(...)` will not map 1:1; open() now returns
the FileAccess object, and lifetime is handled without an explicit close.
